prs.title: fix(vite): keep deduped packages out of importer-based external resolution
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

this works around an issue in nitro with tracing (nitrojs/nitro#4468, see also nitrojs/nitro#4456)

the issue is that when we have absolute paths pointing to the same bare specifier, nitro ends up with output that might have missing files (e.g. in the situation I encountered it, the _newer_ version of vue-router has a `vue-router.node.mjs` which nitro didn't copy because it looked at an older version first)... that needs to be fixed upstream.

but, regardless, this is a bug in nuxt, because we _don't_ want multiple versions of a back that is meant to be deduped, like vue or vue-router.

so this PR ignores absolute-path externalisation for packages specified to be deduped

prs.title: feat(ui-templates): particle mountain loading screen
prs.author: HugoRCD
prs.body:
Replaces the loading screen with a WebGPU particle field that draws a mountain range behind the Nuxt lockup.

- one shader, one draw call, no textures: the range comes from a ridged heightfield sampled in perspective, with occlusion for the skyline
- a clearing keeps the field off the lockup, and hovering it fires a shockwave through the particles
- the progress bar reads `window.__NUXT_LOADING_STATE__` or a `nuxt:loading-state` event, and stays indeterminate without a producer
- without WebGPU the canvas is dropped and the lockup carries the screen; `prefers-reduced-motion` stops the animation entirely

prs.title: feat(nitro,vite): map dev ssr stacktraces and render errors with  `my-bad`
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

follows up on #35587
related to #34593
supersedes #33872, #34404
resolves https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/issues/20204
resolves https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/issues/24109

### 📚 Description

this PR follows up on #35758 to fix the sourcemap issues that were still occurring after that fix.

when hitting a server-side error in development, you get something a bit like this:

```
ReferenceError: foo is not defined
    at Object.<anonymous> (/_nuxt/app/pages/index.vue:1:1)
    at async ...
```

it doesn't include a source position, or code frame. the Youch page we render into an iframe overlay doesn't help much either, because it can't show the frame in _your_ source.

(the issue was that #35758 ended up resolving a second copy of the `vite-node` runner whose `moduleCache` was empty, so `ssrFixStacktrace` had no maps to consult)

so this PR does two things.

1. **it maps dev SSR stacktraces properly.** we now handle mapping in the Nuxt error handler, before anything reads the error.

- inline sourcemaps are read whether or not the data URL carries a `charset` (`vite-node` only recognises the `charset=utf-8` form, which Vite doesn't emit)
- mapped columns are emitted 1-based, as in a V8 stack
- Vite transform failures forwarded over the vite-node socket keep `loc`, `plugin` and `pluginCode`, so error handlers can render an exact position instead of re-parsing `message`
- the maps are then exposed to Nitro as `nitroApp.ssrSourceMaps` (`getSourceMap`, `getCode`, `f

prs.title: feat(nuxt): unified client prefetch scheduler
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

follows up on https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36324

### 📚 Description

we currently prefetch/preload nuxt chunks, components, islands, etc. in an inconsistent way.

| work | before | now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| route chunks (`preloadRouteComponents`) | own 4-slot queue, never cancelled | `route`, cap 4 |
| layout + middleware chunks | unthrottled | `route`, cap 4 |
| `_payload.json` | unthrottled, result discarded after navigating | `payload`, cap 8 |
| island JSON | one `fetch` per island key in the payload | `island`, cap 4 |
| forwarded resource hints | 8 concurrent, 30s timeout | `hint`, cap 8 (unchanged) |
| cross-origin URLs | speculation rules | untouched |

this PR adds one internal scheduler that all of these can now queue onto. now, 'tasks' have:
- **a key** so duplicates are dropped
- **a priority** (as above)
- **a scope** so we can clean up when navigating
- **a group** based on the destination path and query

on navigation we abort in-flight `navigation` work and drop the queue, apart from the payload for the route we're heading to.

previously, we had three different ways of checking for low data; now, we simply hold work in a backlog when `saveData` or 2g is detected, the tab is hidden, or a navigation in progress. (and when any of that changes, we resume it - previously things were just dropped. 😬)

we use the [Prioritized Task Scheduling API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Prioritized_Task_Scheduling_API#browser_co

prs.title: refactor(nuxt,nitro,vite-server): share error handling between the renderer and server builders
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

this shares error handling code between nitro + vite server builders, which otherwise were independently building a `my-bad` report, mapping the stack, etc.

- we now have a new `createDevErrorReporter()` which can be supplied by a builder
- there's now a single `describeError`, `isExpectedError`, `appendVary` and `isJsonRequest`
- we move the `error-500` template into `nuxt`
- we drop the nitro error utils file

.... and more coming in a follow-up PR
